outcome: Composite outcome of death or BPD
cohort: Preterm infants born between 24+0 and 31+6 weeks postmenstrual age (n=7,435)
finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with the incidence of BPD or death or BPD in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not associated with BPD, severe BPD, or death or BPD, even in regions with a high C-section rate.
